integrity: Public mathematical claim is conditional on the cited established integral matching-complex calculation. Chain computations are reproduced by the accompanying standalone script. No external audit is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Only the canonical degree-two universal-coefficient extension for the ordinary matching complex on seven points over the field of three elements is classified; no full modular decomposition or generalization to larger matching complexes is asserted. The foundational integral torsion computation is cited, not independently reproved.
title: An essential modular extension in seven-vertex matching homology
